{{Top|leg}}
'''Bunkurd sewers''' were sewer systems on developed planets established for the introduction of genetically-modified [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] to speed up waste reduction and cleaning of the water. The bacterium was estimated to speed up the reprocessing time by 30%. They were first pioneered on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] several hundred standard years before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Other planets with bunkurd sewers included [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where one was present at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].

Exposure to the bacterium in a living being would result in them contracting [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]].
